ITEM 1 | Orange slices and rounds, bright orange with slightly darker edges, glossy and moist-looking, smooth skin with faint radial fiber lines, soft-cooked and holding shape, cut into rounds about 2.5-3 cm diameter and 0.5-0.8 cm thick, some halved into half-moons, clustered in the center and left of a white square plate spanning about 26 cm | 110
ITEM 2 | Single small yellow-orange cube or disc piece near top-left of pile, slightly paler and more matte than the orange slices, about 1.5 cm across, sitting among the orange slices | 8
ITEM 3 | Thin glossy film or light residue, faint watery sheen on plate surface near the pile, no distinct pooling or thick sauce visible | 3
